title: RTL string and path lint rules
summary: Seven lint rules for RTL string, path and conversion mistakes: swapped Pos arguments, StrictDelimiter, FormatSettings writes, path joins, file-name compares
intro: Use these when a codebase builds paths and parses text by hand. Each rule is a tree-sitter rule, listed by drag-lint rules, switched with --rule or --disable; none has an autofix because every cure changes behaviour in the defective case.
